reference_planes.L0: V100 and auxiliary functional loads; stated functional watts are measured here.
reference_planes.P0: Worst-case 12V_PROTECTED load entry measured to local POWER_GND, after branch convergence and common-bus loss.
reference_planes.S0: Regulated source output measured across each source positive and paired return immediately upstream of the six harness loops.
reference_planes.branch_path: Each A-F loop from S0 through harness, connector/crimp, fuse/holder, limiter, external nFET, branch PCB positive and dedicated return to branch convergence.
reference_planes.common_bus_path: Shared positive and return impedance from branch convergence to worst-case P0.
reference_planes.rule: Every cap includes the stated return contribution; returns may not be omitted or double-counted.

load_accounting.efficiency_definition: The 0.90 floor applies from P0 delivered electrical power to combined L0 functional load power; source-to-P0 conduction loss is separate.

independent_loop_contract.proof_rule: Each loop must meet the 6.000 A floor independently over tolerance and temperature; unused capacity on another loop is inadmissible.
independent_loop_contract.ceiling_scope: The 6.400 A ceiling is the full-tolerance non-fault ceiling; fault transients require separate maximum waveform, clamp, SOA and I2t proof.

limiter_disposition.reason: The guaranteed minimum is below the independent 6.000 A floor; six-loop aggregate capacity cannot cure one deficient loop.
limiter_disposition.replacement_requirement: Select a limiter guaranteed at 6.000-6.400 A over full tolerance and temperature with hot resistance no greater than 57 mOhm.

derating.scope: Selected two-circuit 16-AWG phosphor-bronze connector application screen; installed thermal qualification remains mandatory.

static_ir_budget.basis: Worst-case hot/installed resistance allocation caps, not claims that current candidate parts meet them.
static_ir_budget.precision_rule: Fields suffixed _ohm_exact control calculations; mOhm fields are rounded displays.

transient_pdn_contract.qualification_note: This is a ceiling after the hot static-IR caps while S0 remains at least 12.10 V; extracted or measured inductance, ESR/ESL, control response and ground bounce remain required.

downstream_gates: Exact limiter meeting the full-temperature 6.000-6.400 A and 57 mOhm caps.
Exact fuse and holder meeting 20 mOhm hot plus worst-case time-current and I2t coordination.
Exact nFET meeting 15.625 mOhm hot at actual minimum gate drive plus VDS, reverse-current and SOA limits.
Exact TVS/clamp and fault waveform coordinated with limiter, nFET, harness inductance and PCB copper.
Six connector/crimp and wire-only harness schedules, each separately proving its 20 mOhm hot cap, 6.4 A derating, bundling, ambient and temperature rise.
Extracted or measured PCB branch/return no greater than 15.625 mOhm and shared common positive/return no greater than 1.333333333 mOhm.
PDN and return continuity, ground bounce, ESR/ESL and 300-to-330 W load-step proof.
Six fail-safe FLAG paths, V100 inhibit/reset, brownout and controlled restart timing.
MPA and thermal qualification of all six installed protection paths.
No CAD release before these gates; later serialized CAD requires independent current-HEAD ERC, DRC, connectivity and qualified KiCad Light validation.
assumptions_and_confidence_limits: The 22.7 W auxiliary figure covers all non-V100 functional loads in both cases.
The 0.90 efficiency floor is downstream of P0 and does not hide S0-to-P0 loss.
Resistance values are allocation caps, not measured or qualified current-part values.
Each loop is sized independently; no branch may depend on another branch's unused capacity.
No fabricated temperature, load-step, PDN impedance or fault waveform is claimed.
